description: This file implements core CRUD operations for task management within a backend service, including task creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion, utilizing in-memory storage and UUIDs for task identification. It also includes initialization logic for workspace setup and comments indicating role separation between task logic and user auth handled elsewhere.

methods.name: init_workspace()
methods.description: Initializes the mock workspace, clearing existing tasks.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_user_by_id(user_id: str)
methods.description: Stub function for user lookup, now handled by Supabase Auth.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_task(user_id: str, title: str, description: Optional[str], status: str)
methods.description: Creates a new task associated with a user, assigning a UUID and timestamps.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_tasks(user_id: str)
methods.description: Returns all tasks associated with a specific user.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_task(task_id: str, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific task for a user if it exists.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_task(task_id: str, user_id: str, updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates specified fields of an existing task, refreshing the update timestamp.

methods.name: bool delete_task(task_id: str, user_id: str)
methods.description: Removes a task belonging to a user if it exists.

ctags.name: create_task
ctags.pattern: /^def create_task(user_id: str, title: str, description: Optional[str], status: str) -> Dict[str, /
ctags.signature: (user_id: str, title: str, description: Optional[str], status: str)

ctags.name: get_task
ctags.pattern: /^def get_task(task_id: str, user_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: update_task
ctags.pattern: /^def update_task(task_id: str, user_id: str, updates: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]/
ctags.signature: (task_id: str, user_id: str, updates: Dict[str, Any])
